name: Mikelats
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Mikelats, the Basque storm spirit manifest as Hodei the cloud.
ANATOMY: NO humanoid body, NO face, NO eyes; the being IS ONE overwhelming dark active STORM CLOUD with a distinct curling downward mass, as Hodei/Odei manifestation. [mikelats-c04]
MOMENT: Descend as a massive low stormfront over viewer, cloud rotates and drives a dense diagonal barrage of hailstones into orchard below.
POWER: Large real hailstones strip leaves and batter fruit trees and grainfields; documented destructive storms/hail, NO face hidden in cloud, NO aura or lightning needed. [mikelats-c01,mikelats-c02,mikelats-c04]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or storm gap, strong rim light, deep walnut shadows, ordinary physical dust/moisture.
SURFACE: tactile natural fur/skin/scales where appropriate, coarse opaque textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Basque orchards and fields under a violent dark hailstorm, cloud occupies75% of image and physically acts. [mikelats-c02,mikelats-c04]

Dense hail actively strips orchard leaves and coats ground c01/c02/c04; storm occupies mostframe and action reads dangerous200px. root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and orchard, village and hail-covered-ground crops. The research documents no bodily form. Following the policy's aniconic option (a), the receipt records the choice to show Mikelats in his documented Hodei/Odei 'cloud' manifestation (mikelats-c04) as an active, overwhelming force, not a calm landscape. A colossal black storm cloud curls down in a spiral vortex, low over the viewer, filling about 60% of the frame. A dense diagonal barrage of real hailstones hammers an apple orchard: leaves are stripped, fruit is knocked down, and the ground is white with hail (makes storms, hurls stones and strikes fields and orchards with hail, c01/c02/c04). The sunset gap at the left is the single warm light and rims the cloud. Small white farmhouses in a green valley give scale and Basque context, with no people or victims. No face is hidden in the cloud, and there is no lightning, aura or text. At 200px the spiralling black mass and the hail barrage read as a destructive storm-being descending, dangerous rather than scenic.
